clauses.description: Every substantive clause of the contract, in document order.

name.description: Short name including the clause number if it has one, e.g. "8. Notices".

head.description: The clause's first 8 words, copied EXACTLY as the lines show them. Do not repair the OCR here. If the whole clause is under 16 words, put all of it here.

tail.description: The clause's last 8 words, copied EXACTLY as the lines show them. Do not repair the OCR here. Empty string if the whole clause is already in head.
